lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz) >KORG AudioGate 4 > Adobe Audition CC 2015 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24
source: (FOB) Beyer M160 > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-C90)

ai_review.summary: Awesome audience recording of a sick, high‑energy show with great sound quality.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the vivid, well‑balanced audience capture, calling it an "awesome sounding" and "GREAT Aud" source. The performance itself is described as a "Sick show" and "pretty great", indicating strong energy and musical delivery despite the lack of specific song details.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic reviews (4‑ and 5‑star) praise both the recording quality and the show, yielding a high combined rating; limited sample size lowers confidence to medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced audience capture described as "awesome sounding" with no reported glitches or mix problems.
